name: no-claude-help
description: Keeps coding agents off the byline: no co-authored-by trailers, no session URLs, no generated-with footers, no agent contributors, and every commit authored by the human.

author_identity.title: Commit identity
author_identity.description: Type the only identity commits may carry, as "Name <email>". Leave empty to use the existing git user.name and user.email.

auto_install_git_hooks.title: Install git hooks automatically
auto_install_git_hooks.description: Type true or false. Leave empty for the default (true), which installs the enforcement hooks into each repository you open so the rule holds for other agents, editors and CI too.

strict_mode.title: Strict mode
strict_mode.description: Type true or false. Leave empty for the default (false). When true, generic [bot] commit identities are rejected as well as known AI agents; release and dependency bots stay allowed.
